rationale: Best-supported call is non-AI for the historical NetProspex data-services/contact-data product. Dun & Bradstreet's 2015 acquisition announcement describes contact databases, data management, data cleansing/enrichment, target-market analysis and audience acquisition, not AI functionality. Current D&B AI offerings concern the broader present-day vendor and are not evidence about this historical product. The single historical announcement is not a complete feature inventory, therefore negative evidence remains weak/forced.
version_scope: D&B acquisition announcement dated 2015-01-08 is directly relevant historical evidence. Product name is a legacy offering; no source-record release/version is provided.
issues: Historical official product documentation beyond the acquisition announcement was not located; cannot prove complete included-feature coverage.

sources.applicability: D&B's January 2015 acquisition release gives direct historical description of NetProspex's product and operation; it is hosted by a press-release distributor.
